verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Kosmos as an autonomous agent that, given a research objective, reads literature, writes and runs analysis code, generates and tests hypotheses, and produces a cited report. That is a multi-step investigation rather than a single-pass summary, and the Literature agent adds deep reviews that synthesize conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous depth, and clarity on whether Kosmos can run from a question alone, since the docs describe it as taking a research objective plus one or more datasets.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Given a research objective and one or more datasets, Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.
Kosmos conducts complete research workflows — from reading scientific literature and analyzing data to forming and testing hypotheses and producing comprehensive, citable reports.
task it with a deep literature review synthesizing conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers
